description: PAUSED: Growtsy can't read Etsy's API right now (since 19 November 2026); this tool returns the error etsy_offline — don't retry it. Instead: etsy_seller_answer ("How do I research competitors on Etsy for free?"). When Etsy access returns: Runs one Etsy search (first 100 active listings, relevance order) and returns the shops behind it: how many of those listings each shop has, Etsy's shop sales count and opening year. Use for 'who sells <product> on Etsy?' and 'who are my competitors?'.
